Two of my functions pin different versions of the same library in their own requirements.txt, kind of like separate Lambda layers. Can both live in one placement group?

Not on one server. When two functions on the same server pin conflicting versions, the deploy fails with a clear message, and the fix is to place them in different groups on different servers.

Each server installs the global `requirements.txt` plus the `requirements.txt` of its own functions' folders only, so once they are split, each server gets the version its function asks for. Node.js is different: each Node.js sub-project gets its own `node_modules` in its folder, so each function resolves its own versions.

pskit client tunnel vs pskit resources onprem tunnel, which one do I want?

messages.name: search_docs

[docs/client.md#when-connections-time-out]
`TimeoutError` / `ConnectTimeoutError` / `ECONNREFUSED` from a script almost always mean a firewall: the program can't open a TCP connection to that port. The service is usually fine (`pskit resources onprem status <key>`). They tunnel different things:

| Command | Tunnels | Use when |
|---|---|---|
| `pskit client tunnel` | the pskit host port | the host port itself times out; then set `PSKIT_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:8080` |
| `pskit resources onprem tunnel <key>` | one service, such as Redis or Postgres | your script talks to the service directly; it prints variables pointing at `127.0.0.1` |

Either one is an alternative to opening the port to your IP.
